scope: One preregistered eight-case MuJoCo/BAM unified-policy experiment. Retained negative motion outcomes; not Newton, ordinary MCP or hardware admission.
source_scope: Standalone CPU harness with exact upstream PolicyInference and one VelStand session; no production locomotion policy or runtime behavior changed.

reference_script.selector: Single walking_session, no standing_session: no switch. walking maps vel_cmd to twist slots.
reference_script.modes: No sitstand posture flag, ground_pick phase, behavior, head or body mode active.
reference_script.observation: Raw gyro, projected gravity, q-HOME, dq, previous committed raw14, raw command13; graph owns normalization.

single_policy.normalization: embedded Sub/Div; raw observations supplied once

contract.selection: VelStand during preparation, DRIVE and full-zero terminal tail. Only one walking_session exists; no standing_session, reset or blend.
contract.preparation: Changing the preparation policy changes the state before the first command. The experiment evaluates the whole candidate, not an isolated change to braking.
contract.command: Original geometric controller: vx +/-0.3 while DRIVE, completed-observation heading feedback, zero head/body channels. Full zero outside DRIVE; no predictive cutoff or case-specific phase selection.
contract.history: Previous committed raw14 remains continuous. Original pre/post-inference cancellation/deadline fences; one history/target commit per admitted policy slot.
contract.vetos: Original distance, lateral/heading, pose, contact, deadline and rest criteria. Quiet tails do not repair failed travel.

cadence.baseline: First completed solve after commanded onset; no pre-command positive credit
cadence.stop: Decision after a completed solve; exact zero at next unchanged 50Hz policy slot

telemetry.purpose: Preserve all actuator observations for one unified-policy candidate; no BAM gains, poses or limits change.
telemetry.pre_update: Existing q_target/q/dq, data.time, last_ts, nominal vin and previous motor torque used by the sag model.
telemetry.inside_update: Observe actual clamp requested/limited duty, effective BAM vin, returned volts and returned motor torque; original methods called once.
telemetry.post_update_pre_solve: ctrl is BAM torque requested from MuJoCo; restored vin and new friction/damping coefficients.
telemetry.post_mj_step: Copy actuator_force and generalized actuator/passive/constraint/bias buffers after the original step, plus advanced q/dq. Force buffers belong to the last dynamics evaluation and are not claimed co-temporal with integrated q/dq.
telemetry.metadata: Exact actuator/joint/dof mapping, gear/gain/bias/dynamics, ctrl and force limits, integration/enable flags, and geom-body map.

unavailable.current_a: No direct current field; max_current=None stays unchanged.
unavailable.torque_before_pwm_limit_nm: Original voltage control computes raw PWM duty, not pre-limit torque.

telemetry.inference_limits: No torque/kt current synthesis, hypothetical unclipped torque, hardware measurement or saturation claim from proximity alone. Separate actual PWM clipping from ctrl/force differences and from net joint load.
telemetry.lifecycle: Instance-only wrappers return original objects, detach capture arrays, restore original attribute state on close/error. Capture failures fail the case and retain partial calls; no duplicate motor law/forward/step/inference.
telemetry.numerical_comparison: Array-law tests prove wrappers preserve original results and single-call behavior. Future captures may be compared to retained previous arrays; no invariance is claimed before execution.

limitations: BAM vin is a simulated internal supply parameter; no measured current or pre-PWM torque is exposed.
PWM clipping is counted from observed requested and limited duty; it does not alone establish a cause of drift.
ctrl is the torque request; force buffers are the last dynamics evaluation and are not co-temporal with integrated q/dq.
Generalized actuator force is not net joint torque. Proximity to a force bound alone does not establish clipping.
Force-buffer equality to clipped ctrl is checked only for the recorded fixed-gain motor, unit gear, disabled joint-force clamp and Euler recipe.
Policy phase is the command held for this solve, including slots still held when a later per-solve veto fires.
actuator_scope.interpretation: No recorded PWM clamp or ctrl/actuator-force difference; effective voltage remains above 6V. This does not identify the physical or training cause of insufficient travel.

interpretation: Both datasets use the same controller and plant, but different policy during preparation and DRIVE. This is not a matched-state causal policy-response comparison.

Velstand keeps all 150 DRIVE slots in each case and never enters the target tolerance. Failure is insufficient travel before the unchanged solve budget; it is not failed rest after attaining the target.
Recorded twist reaches obs[48:51] with all ten head/body slots zero. No missing mode bit or accidental zero-command routing was found in the exact inference source.
Observed action changes do not identify training provenance, command sensitivity at a matched state, or the physical cause of insufficient travel. No new inference or simulator call is performed.
All eight terminate at the original 600-action-solve bound with no geometric tolerance entry and no active pose/contact/lateral/heading veto. None enters BRAKE or HOLD.

At the deadline, forward body displacement is about 11.1mm and reverse about -2.45mm. The later full-zero tail returns close to the starting pose; the final tail displacement is distinct from displacement at the motion deadline.

Raw-action phase distributions and their changes are retained in the analysis artifact. Different preparation states and action interval lengths prohibit a matched-state causal comparison with the previous expert pair.
The same VelStand hash already failed historical native velocity-tracking objectives. This CPU capture does not supersede those negatives or establish a newly trained policy.

The ONNX contract is 61 observations and 14 actions, feed-forward with embedded normalization. Release asset provenance is pinned; no exact training checkpoint/commit is recovered from its run_path=None metadata.
